page_title: Git notifications on your menu bar - Gitify

summary.name: Gitify
summary.one_liner: Gitify is a free, open-source menu bar app that shows real-time notifications from multiple Git hosting services.
use_cases: Keep track of GitHub notifications without opening a browser
Monitor GitLab or Bitbucket activity from the menu bar
Filter a busy Git notification inbox to important items
Receive native desktop alerts for new Git notifications
Watch notifications across self-hosted GitHub Enterprise Server or Gitea/Forgejo instances
summary.what_it_does: Gitify sits in the menu bar and delivers real-time notifications from GitHub Cloud, GitHub Enterprise Cloud and Server, Gitea (including Forgejo and Codeberg), GitLab (Cloud and Self-Managed), and Bitbucket Cloud. It includes filtering so users can narrow their notification inbox to what matters. Users can choose to show native OS notifications, play a notification sound, or change the app's appearance. The app is built with TypeScript, Electron, and React, and is released free under the MIT license.
notable: Supports many Git hosts: GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, Gitea/Forgejo/Codeberg, GitLab, and Bitbucket Cloud
Built with Electron, React, TypeScript; MIT-licensed and open to contributions
Notification filtering plus native OS notifications and sound options
caveats: Platform list (macOS, Windows, Linux) is not stated on the page text; it is inferred from the Electron build and the menu bar framing, so treat it as unconfirmed
